purpose: Make FOUNDRY CORE, FIELD INDEX, MIGRATION and CONFLUENCE read as unequal views over the same durable collaboration state without creating a new database, scheduler, ontology or runtime authority.
center: Turn lived uncertainty into manipulable state, transform it deliberately across media, and get evidence back without losing identity, provenance or the path home.

views.question: What must survive a lawful transformation?
What exists, where is it, what can it do, and where are its open ports?
What exact thing existed, what evidence supports it, and what is its recovery disposition?
What bounded mechanism can cross from one lineage to another, what must it preserve, and what recipient-side evidence would earn adoption?

shared_authorities.reality: domain owners such as /house/; no projection substitutes for observed world state

cycle: FIELD identifies the addressed host, capability or missing port.
MIGRATION recovers exact source/evidence when a donor or lineage claim is needed.
CONFLUENCE packages only the bounded transferable mechanism.
The recipient changes under its own authority and emits evidence.
RETURN closes that move; subsequent work is replanned from returned state.

vocabulary_alignment.rule: Do not collapse independent dimensions merely to make labels match.
vocabulary_alignment.field_state: Lifecycle/evidence posture of a public route (ACTIVE, STABLE, PROOF_REQUIRED, CANDIDATE, DONOR, FROZEN_DONOR, RECOVER, etc.).
vocabulary_alignment.migration_status: Recovery disposition (LIVE_HEAD, LIVE_DONOR, RECOVER, IMPORT, MERGE_CANDIDATE, QUARANTINE). It is not the FIELD lifecycle state.
vocabulary_alignment.confluence_status: Transfer posture (for example IMPLEMENTED, PROOF_REQUIRED, PROPOSED). Adoption is recipient-side and evidence-bearing.
vocabulary_alignment.core_status: Canonical confidence of the slow model. CANON_CANDIDATE is explicitly revisable.

known_gaps: CONFLUENCE has only a small machine-readable transfer registry; expand it only when a packet has explicit donor/source, transfer unit, recipient, test and RETURN.
Some child workbenches inherit a parent release boundary and have no independent receipt. Do not describe them as independently verified releases without evidence.
Historical counts or labels must carry an evidence address or remain qualitative.
